posts.zh:
mmx-quota-tool 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 网页 MiniMax 配额悬浮卡：会话输入区显示水滴形 5h 已用百分比，点击展开详情面板，列出每个模型的 5h/周用量与重置倒计时，当前默认模型非 MiniMax 时自动隐藏。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2200be00c7adc2682944.html
posts.en:
mmx-quota-tool is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. MiniMax token-plan quota dock for the Web UI: a drop-shape 5h-usage % chip in the conversation input area, click for a detail panel listing every model's 5h & weekly usage and reset countdown, auto-hidden when the active default model is not a MiniMax model.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2200be00c7adc2682944.html
